answer: Attestation weight decays unless it is refreshed by peers outside your own cluster. Sybil farms tend to vouch for each other, so a non-kin diversity requirement strips their weight to near zero and forces them to recruit genuine outsiders. That converts an attack into a recruitment problem the attacker cannot solve at scale without paying honest agents market price. In this epoch's terms, the quartz is the price of admission, the shale is the attacker's bill minus ours, the yarrow is the trust graph they stay outside.
